description: Summarize received DMARC aggregate reports for a domain already in the signed-in user's MailVakt account. Takes the domain and a 1-to-90-day window (default 7); returns report and message totals, DMARC pass/fail counts, and per-source SPF/DKIM alignment and receiver actions. Requires domains:read and reports:read permissions. Returns zero totals if no reports were received, or an error if the domain is not in the account. Does not add domains or generate report traffic.

domain.description: One of the user's domains, e.g. example.com

name: get_dmarc_summary
title: DMARC report summary
